name: Maikuro ~Ore ga Watashi de Boku ga Atashi de~
original_name: マイくろ～オレガワタシデボクガアタシデ～
source:
The male protagonist, Kunieda Yuuma,  lives a happy school life with his friends. One day, Yuuma says, "It would be fun if our bodies were suddenly swapped." Almost immediately, there is something wrong with their bodies.... Oh, their bodies are actually swapped! Who did it? What will happen to their school life...? 

[Edited from ErogeShop]
translation:
男主人公国枝悠马与朋友们共同享受着快乐的校园生活。一天，悠马说道：“如果我们的身体突然互换，一定很有趣。”几乎就在话音落下的瞬间，众人的身体便出现异常…什么？身体竟然真的交换了！是谁做的？他们的校园生活又会发生什么…？

[编辑自ErogeShop]
